title.zh: 【慢雾：DarkSword 木马已被投入实际攻击，部分 iOS 26 版本也受影响】
title.en: 【慢雾：DarkSword 木马已被投入实际攻击，部分 iOS 26 版本也受影响】

current_state.zh: SlowMist warns that the DarkSword-PROV2 trojan is actively exploited to steal iOS Keychain data, files, messages, and crypto wallet information via malicious Safari pages on affected iOS 18.6–18.7.2 and iOS 26.0–26.1 devices.
current_state.en: SlowMist warns that the DarkSword-PROV2 trojan is actively exploited to steal iOS Keychain data, files, messages, and crypto wallet information via malicious Safari pages on affected iOS 18.6–18.7.2 and iOS 26.0–26.1 devices.
